title: How to View Customer Summary Reports in Swash Laundry Software (SLS)
description:
How to View the Customer Summary Report in Swash Laundry Software (SLS)

Welcome to the official Swash Laundry Software (SLS) tutorial series.

In this video, you'll learn how to generate and view the Customer Summary Report in Swash Laundry Software. This report provides a complete overview of customer information, order activity, payment details, and account status, helping you manage customer records more effectively.

In this video, you'll learn:
How to open the Customer Summary Report
How to search for a customer
How to apply filters and date ranges
How to view customer order history
How to check payment summaries
How to print or export the report
Best practices for analyzing customer data
